Ensuring technical solutions meet project requirements, budgets and deadlines. Identifying potential deviations or design challenges and taking appropriate action. Monitoring engineering progress and communicating clearly with project stakeholders. Every project brings new technical challenges, giving you the opportunity to apply your expertise and contribute to complex maritime engineering solutions.
